rows.new_mangalore_port_authority_nmpa_karnat: New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore

MEO Second Class Motor Certificate (MS Act, 1958) with 06 months experience, failing which MEO Class IV(FG) with 06 months experience, failing which MEO Class III (NCV-SEO) with 12 months experience OR MEO Class IV (NCV) with 24 months experience; plus Certificate under Regulation III/4 read with I/3 STCW 95 / Inland Vessels Act
Upper age limit of 45 years is for Direct Recruitment; age does not apply to absorption/deputation (as on 28 December 2026)
The Secretary, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore - 575 010

content_sections.heading: NMPA Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 2026/2910//CERS.6 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NMPA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MEO Second Class Motor Certificate issued under MS Act, 1958 with 06 months experience; failing which MEO Class IV(FG) with 06 months experience; failing which MEO Class III(NCV-SEO) with 12 months experience OR MEO Class IV (NCV) with 24 months experience; Certificate issued under Regulation III/4 read with I/3 STCW 95 / Inland Vessels Act Experience: As given with each certificate (06, 12 or 24 months); applicants must be eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities Age limit: Upper age limit of 45 years is for Direct Recruitment; age does not apply to absorption/deputation (as on 28 December 2026) Other conditions: Open only to eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities Applications must come through proper channel via the concerned Port Eligibility judged as on last date of receipt of application, 28.12.2026

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NMPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications without all requisite documents by 13.01.2027 will not be considered Additional time till 13.01.2027 only if advance copy received by 28.12.2026

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation period 3 years, extendable to 4 years In exceptional circumstances extendable to 5 years by Central Government (HOD post) or Chairman (post below HOD level) Probation of 02 years as per Recruitment Rules Undertaking that candidature will not be withdrawn if selected

rows.event: Last date for applications (advance copy) to reach NMPA by post or email
Last date for Ports to forward applications with documents

content_sections.heading: How Will NMPA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Consideration of applications received through proper channel with requisite documents.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certified copies of APARs for last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26), attested by officer not below Dy.HOD on each page Statement of year-wise APAR availability and grading signed by Head of Office/HOD (No Report Certificate if APAR unavailable) Attested copies of educational and experience certificates, verified by Head of Office/HOD No objection certificate from the respective Port Undertaking (Annexure-III), Vigilance and Administrative Clearance (Annexure-IV), employer certificate (Annexure-V) Two latest passport size photographs in a transparent envelope

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NMPA Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the prescribed proforma at Annexure-II (Format of Application). Submit through the parent Major Port, which forwards applications of officers satisfying the Recruitment Rules. Superscribe envelope: Application for the post of Engineer Grade-II (Class-II). Send to the Secretary, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore - 575 010, by post or email, to reach on or before 28.12.2026. Ports may then forward eligible applications with listed documents by post/e-mail to reach by 13.01.2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: NMPA may change the vacancy circular and annexures; changes will be circulated to all Major Ports before the last date Recruitment Rules: by absorption/deputation failing which by Direct Recruitment

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NMPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 28 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NMPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Engineer Grade-II (Class-II).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NMPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II (Format of Application) of this PDF) and send it to The Secretary, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore - 575 010, by post or email (advance copy); ports forward with documents by post / e-mail, to reach by 28 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 40,000 - 1,40,000 scale of pay.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MEO Second Class Motor Certificate (MS Act, 1958) with 06 months experience, failing which MEO Class IV(FG) with 06 months experience, failing which MEO Class III (NCV-SEO) with 12 months experience OR MEO Class IV (NCV) with 24 months experience; plus Certificate under Regulation III/4 read with I/3 STCW 95 / Inland Vessels Act.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open only to eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities. Applications must come through proper channel via the concerned Port. Eligibility judged as on last date of receipt of application, 28.12.2026.

faq.answer: Applications without all requisite documents by 13.01.2027 will not be considered. Additional time till 13.01.2027 only if advance copy received by 28.12.2026.

faq.answer: Consideration of applications received through proper channel with requisite documents.

faq.answer: Deputation period 3 years, extendable to 4 years. In exceptional circumstances extendable to 5 years by Central Government (HOD post) or Chairman (post below HOD level). Probation of 02 years as per Recruitment Rules.
